tools.name: get_stock_insider_transactions
tools.title: Stock Insider Transactions
tools.description:
Get monthly CVM insider transaction reports from /api/v2/stocks/insider-transactions. Rows group controllers, board members, directors, fiscal council, and other statutory bodies with related persons. Rows do not name each person or the traded ticker. The ticker selects the reporting company, so PETR3 and PETR4 return the same reports. credit and debit also include transfers, loans, and grants; use movementType for purchases and sales. quantity, unitPrice, and volume are exact decimal strings. The default window is the last 365 days. Pro plan.

Authentication: required. Sign in to brapi or provide a valid Bearer token before calling this tool.

Plan access: this dataset may require a paid plan. Call get_account_capabilities when limits are unclear.

Use the exact parameter names and formats shown in inputSchema.

symbols.description: Required. Use the exact key `symbols`, not `tickers` or `symbol`. Pass comma-separated B3 ticker symbols, e.g. "PETR4" or "PETR4,VALE3".

startDate.description: Transaction start date. Default: 365 days before endDate in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. "2026-08-25"

endDate.description: Transaction end date. Default: today in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. "2026-08-25"

companyRelation.description: Issuer of the security: the reporting company, its parent, or its subsidiary. Default "company"

direction.description: credit adds to the position; debit removes from it

roleGroup.description: Role group. Each group includes related persons

movementType.description: Exact report text, e.g. "Compra à vista" or "Venda à vista"

allVersions.description: Include earlier report versions. Default false. Earlier versions can repeat rows; do not sum them

limit.description: Transactions per company and page, max 100, default 50

tools.name: get_stock_screener
tools.title: Stock Screener
tools.description:
Filter and rank B3 stocks by price and fundamentals from /api/v2/stocks/screener: P/L, P/VP, dividend yield, ROE, margins, debt, growth, and more. One call scans every asset. Each metric accepts {metric}Min and {metric}Max, inclusive, in the units of the response: fractions use 0.06 for 6% (dividendYield, returnOnEquity, margins, growth); changePercent uses 2.81 for 2.81%; prices and amounts are BRL. A filter drops assets without that value. Companies with a loss have a negative trailingPE, so for "P/L below 8" send trailingPEMin=0 and trailingPEMax=8. sortBy accepts any metric key, symbol, or name (default marketCap, desc); nulls sort last. page starts at 1; limit max 200, default 20. Startup and Pro plans. Pro metrics (returnOnEquity, returnOnAssets, grossMargin, ebitdaMargin, operatingMargin, debtToEquity, netDebtToEbitda, currentRatio, quickRatio, revenueGrowth, earningsGrowth, revenueGrowthAnnual, earningsGrowthAnnual, totalRevenue, ebitda, freeCashflow, totalDebt, totalCash) need the Pro plan: a filter or sort with them on Startup returns PLAN_LIMIT, and Startup results omit them. The free plan has no access.

Use the exact parameter names and formats shown in inputSchema.

Authentication: required. Sign in to brapi or provide a valid Bearer token before calling this tool.

Plan access: this dataset may require a paid plan. Call get_account_capabilities when limits are unclear.

Use the exact parameter names and formats shown in inputSchema.

symbols.description: Comma-separated B3 fund symbols, max 20. Example: JURO11,XPCA11

cnpjs.description: Comma-separated CNPJs, formatted or digits-only, max 20

tools.name: get_fip_reports

cnpjs.description: Comma-separated CNPJs, formatted or digits-only, max 20

startDate.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format

endDate.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format

tools.name: get_treasury_list
tools.title: List Treasury Bonds
tools.description:
List Tesouro Direto public bonds with current indicative rates and prices. Supports filtering by public symbol/name, indexer (selic, prefixado, ipca, igpm), coupon type, sorting and pagination.

Authentication: required. Sign in to brapi or provide a valid Bearer token before calling this tool.

Plan access: this dataset may require a paid plan. Call get_account_capabilities when limits are unclear.

Use the exact parameter names and formats shown in inputSchema.

search.description: Search by public treasury symbol or bond name. Example: "tesouro-selic-01032031"

couponType.description: Filter by coupon type: zero or semestral

tools.name: get_treasury_indicators
tools.title: Treasury Bond Rates
tools.description:
Get the latest indicative rates and prices for one or more Tesouro Direto public bonds. Symbols are public brapi slugs like tesouro-selic-01032031.

Authentication: required. Sign in to brapi or provide a valid Bearer token before calling this tool.

Plan access: this dataset may require a paid plan. Call get_account_capabilities when limits are unclear.

Use the exact parameter names and formats shown in inputSchema.

symbols.description: Comma-separated treasury symbols (max 20). Example: "tesouro-selic-01032031,tesouro-ipca-15052035"

tools.name: get_treasury_indicators_history
tools.title: Treasury Bond Rate History
tools.description:
Get daily historical Tesouro Direto rates and unit prices for one or more public bonds. When dates are omitted, returns the last 12 months.

Authentication: required. Sign in to brapi or provide a valid Bearer token before calling this tool.

Plan access: this dataset may require a paid plan. Call get_account_capabilities when limits are unclear.

Use the exact parameter names and formats shown in inputSchema.

symbols.description: Comma-separated treasury symbols (max 20). Example: "tesouro-selic-01032031"

startDate.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format (default: 12 months ago)

endDate.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format (default: today)
